messages:
Sam (sales): Heads up — AcmeAI POC wants a 30-day grace window on autoscale overages tied to their dedicated GPU commit. They want burst usage during the first month of ramp without immediate overage charges. Can we do this?
Leena (se): Quick Q — is this for a new commit or an add-on to an existing reserved pool?
Sam (sales): New commit: 12x A100 equivalent reserve, will autoscale to burst GPUs (~20% of peak) for first 30 days. Asking for grace + a 50% discount on burst rate for that period.
Aaron (finance): Discount asks: 50% on burst rate is big. Need to see projected token-hours. Can you share expected percent utilization?
Sam (sales): They expect steady 70% of commit after week 2, but week 1 has spikes where burst = ~18% of total. Total monthly spend est: commit base $48k + burst ~$6k without discount.
Dom (devops): Operational note — we can tag burst as "grace-burst" so metrics isolate. But autoscale rules still apply; billing truly records tokens. Finance needs a written carveout to zero-out overage invoices for first 30d.
Leena (se): Also need to confirm burst mix — are they OK with mixed GPU types? That affects kernel perf and effective rate. If burst includes cheaper cards, effective cost drops.
Sam (sales): They want flexibility to burst into mixed pool across regions (us-west/us-east). Prefers minimal infra friction.
Aaron (finance): Proposed path: approve a time-limited credit equal to actual measured burst charges up to $X (cap). Finance comfortable with a credit, not a permanent rate override. Need deal desk approval + legal clause for one-time credit.
Sam (sales): Sounds reasonable. Can deal desk approve a one-time credit for first 30 days capped at $7k and a special note that future overages billed normally? @dealdesk-bot can you record an escalation?
Leena (se): From product/SE POV: recommend we also enable KV prefix caching for their POC — reduces token runaways during spikes. That lowers expected burst. Will push config in the POC config: caching: prefix=true, max_cached_tokens=512.
Dom (devops): If we tag the pool and add the credit, we should also set an autoscale policy: start_scale=commit, burst_cap=25%, cooldown=300s. That keeps tail risk controlled.
Aaron (finance): I can sign off on a credit up to $7k if legal adds the carveout clause and we document the burst tag. Need approval final from deal desk.
Sam (sales): OK I'll prepare the deal doc and the POC runbook. Requesting deal desk review now.
dealdesk-bot: Escalation logged — ticket DD-2024-1137 created. Please attach: 1) one-page economics (commit, burst, cap), 2) POC runbook, 3) legal credit clause draft. Reaction :white_check_mark: when uploaded.
Sam (sales): Uploaded econ snapshot and runbook to the ticket. Link: https://intranet.redwood/dd/DD-2024-1137
Leena (se): Will upload config snippet and expected perf numbers later today.
Aaron (finance): Once ticket has documents I will mark tentative approval and route to legal for the clause.
Dom (devops): I'll provision the tagged pool with the autoscale policy once we get final sign-off.
Sam (sales): Thanks team — ping me if you need sample invoice wording for zeroing first-month overages.
Leena (se): Quick sample: "Customer will receive a one-time credit equal to actual burst charges up to $7,000 for the initial 30-day POC period. Thereafter, standard burst rates apply."
Aaron (finance): Good. I'll add it to the ticket.
dealdesk-bot: Note: awaiting legal approval. If legal signs off by EOD tomorrow, finance will issue credit in next billing cycle.
